name: mirage
text: Checked. Public final scores are available for that game (ESPN has Hornets @ Pistons, Oct 28, final 97-89), and the Tracker already grades ordinary bets from them (5,324 settled). That one is stuck for a different reason: you hold both sides of the market, and Novig's payout row ($0.02) fits neither side's winnings. A test deliberately protects that case, since a feed-based win could book the wrong money if Novig voided or fair-valued the market. So it's left for a tap on purpose. I didn't change anything. If you want, I can make these grade from the final score and book the money as the net of what Novig actually paid, split to the winning side. That's a small change but it touches money maths, so tell me if you want it.
